prize_tracks.title: Matura Best Score
prize_tracks.goal: Highest honest Sunday exam score under the 8.0 GB base / 8.8 GB after-FT caps.
prize_tracks.summary: Gemma 4 12B QAT GGUF + mmproj now leads Claude-graded 60-pt results with 68.3% on the May 2023 CKE paper at 7.16 GB, but the standing Sunday gauge remains history-2023-mock-v1, where speakleash Bielik-4.5 FP8 is still the best verified pack at Claude 40.0% with parallel Grok/Sol reads of 46.7% / 48.3% on the same answers. Prior 37.6% AWQ figure is headline-auto only and demoted.

prize_tracks.title: Matura Best Progress
prize_tracks.goal: Largest tuned minus honest bare-base improvement on the Sunday exam.
prize_tracks.summary: Same-HF-base pair locked: Bielik-11B-v2 NF4 raw 25.5% → routed harness 26.9% (Δ +1.4 pp). Declared organisers base stays this NF4 pack for Best Progress only; progress-dapt next. Gauge is matura_all holdout (not yet history-2023-mock-v1). Proxy 3B CKE +1.6 still secondary.

prize_tracks.title: Matura Mały ale wariat
prize_tracks.goal: Smallest model that still reaches at least 35% on the honest Sunday exam.
prize_tracks.summary: speakleash Bielik-4.5 FP8 (~4.898 GB) remains the Mały floor and primary contender on the standing gauge: 40.0% Claude on history-2023-mock-v1, with parallel Grok/Sol judges at 46.7% / 48.3% on the same answers. Gemma 4 12B QAT GGUF + mmproj reached 68.3% Claude on the May 2023 paper at 7.16 GB, well above 35% and under the cap, but it is larger than the Bielik floor and does not take the Mały lead. E2E 3B is 25.0% Grok. New Claude official-mock sub-2B probes failed: Qwen2.5-0.5B at 5.0% and Qwen2.5-1.5B at 6.7%, supporting C-027 (no more GPU on sub-2B; 3/2-bit 4B first).
